description: Today's Morning Brief from 787daily: the day's top Puerto Rico stories as the brief curates them, in its order, each with its one-line takeaway. Each story's url is 787daily's summary page; sourceUrl is the outlet's original report, most of them in Spanish (null for 787daily's own pieces). moreAt is the brief itself. Returns summaries + links only; for the newest stories as they publish, use keyword_search_news with no query.
name: get_daily_briefing
